**FRI 2/2/24 – NIGHT – L. Grant**

2200 – Took over from D. Reyes. Keys on hook. She said the gate was already fixed, they came out this afternoon. Good.

2215 – Patrol 1: all clear. Gate working fine now.

2330 – Office check: nothing out of place.

0100 – Patrol 2: clear.

0230 – Rain started, moderate. Checked the drains by the loading dock, they were running clear.

0400 – Patrol 3: all clear, rain let up.

0545 – Handed over to D. Reyes. She said the weekend crew would be doing inventory in Building B, so expect lights on in there.

– Lucas Grant

---

2205 – Took over from D. Reyes. Keys on hook. She said inventory crew was still in Building B, they'd be done by 2300.

2215 – Patrol 1: Building B had lights on, heard voices, all normal. Rest of perimeter clear.

2300 – Building B lights went off, crew left. Checked the door, locked.

0300 – Patrol 3: clear. Quiet night.

– Lucas Grant
